Combine ggplots into one tagged, journal-styled composite

Source: R/export.R
olinkviz_combine.Rd

Wrapper around patchwork that arranges several panels, wraps any panel that is itself a composite (such as [plot_upset()]) so it receives a single tag, applies the journal's panel-tag case and point size (`"a"` at 8 pt bold for Nature, `"A"` at 9 pt for Cell Press, 10 pt for Science), and collects shared legends. Requires the `patchwork` package.

Usage

olinkviz_combine(
  ...,
  ncol = NULL,
  nrow = NULL,
  design = NULL,
  widths = NULL,
  heights = NULL,
  guides = c("collect", "keep"),
  tag_levels = "a",
  journal = getOption("olinkviz.journal", "nature"),
  tag_size = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL
)

Arguments

...

ggplot objects to combine, in row-major order, or a single list of them.

ncol, nrow

Grid dimensions; leave both `NULL` to let patchwork choose a layout.

design

Optional custom layout passed through to [patchwork::wrap_plots()].

widths, heights

Relative panel widths / heights passed to [patchwork::plot_layout()].

guides

`"collect"` (default) merges identical legends into one; `"keep"` leaves each panel's own legend in place.

tag_levels

Panel-tag style passed to [patchwork::plot_annotation()] - `"a"`, `"A"`, `"1"`, or `NULL` to skip tagging. Leave unset to pick the case from `journal`.

journal

Any registered journal id (see [journal_specs()]). Defaults to `getOption("olinkviz.journal", "nature")`.

tag_size

Panel-tag size in pt; `NULL` (default) uses the journal's.

title, subtitle

Composite-level title / subtitle.

Value

A `patchwork` object ready for [save_olinkviz()] or [olinkviz_preflight()].

See also

Other export: labs_panel(), save_olinkviz()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p1 <- plot_boxplot(probc[probc$Timepoint == 1, ], assay = "IL6",
                     group = "Project", test = "none")
  p2 <- plot_boxplot(probc[probc$Timepoint == 1, ], assay = "TNF",
                     group = "Project", test = "none")
  olinkviz_combine(p1, p2, journal = "nature", title = "Baseline cytokines")
}
